# lint commands

Every `lint` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `lint:deferred-slots`

Report slots whose deferred declaration and page template disagree.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:deferred-slots
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--strict` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `lint:deferred-twig`

Validate deferred Twig templates against the Semitexa frontend rendering subset.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:deferred-twig
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `lint:di`

Verify DI injection rules on all container-managed classes

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:di
```

## `lint:handlers`

Validate handler signatures, return types, and payload/resource bindings

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:handlers
```

## `lint:inline-script`

Find inline `<script>` blocks that a strict CSP would refuse.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:inline-script
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--strict` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `lint:mechanisms`

Report application code that hand-rolls a framework mechanism, naming the capability it should use.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:mechanisms
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--path` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `lint:resources`

Validate ResourceDTO classes, attributes, and the relation metadata graph.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:resources
```

## `lint:responses`

Verify no HttpResponse construction in application code

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:responses
```

## `lint:scoping`

Verify container-managed classes with #[InjectAsMutable] properties have explicit scoping attributes

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:scoping
```

## `lint:skin-legacy`

Handled by the `bin/semitexa` wrapper before PHP starts.

## `lint:skin-tokens`

Handled by the `bin/semitexa` wrapper before PHP starts.

## `lint:templates`

Validate template directory conventions across all modules.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:templates
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--strict` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `lint:test-integrity`

Fail when a change removes or weakens test checks without saying why

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:test-integrity
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--path` | yes |
| `--base` | yes |
| `--renamed-from` | yes |
| `--renamed-to` | yes |

## `lint:transport-doors`

Fail on a framework-internal /__ route that is not KISS, HUG, a system page or a dev tool.

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:transport-doors
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `lint:var-artifacts`

Fail when git would commit runtime output (screenshots, traces, exports) from a var/ directory

```bash
bin/semitexa lint:var-artifacts
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--path` | yes |
